fields.description: Aurea brings one, two and three bedroom apartments to the promenade at Rashid Yachts & Marina. Emaar’s design pairs broad glazing and terraces with a landscaped amenities podium. The setting connects the homes to waterfront walks, shops and dining, with marina, park and skyline outlooks dependent on the apartment selected.

overview: The marina promenade is central to Aurea’s proposed daily life: a pedestrian waterfront with retail, cafés and leisure destinations beyond the residential entrance. The brochure pairs this public setting with quieter spaces for swimming, exercise, yoga and informal gatherings. Apartments use open living arrangements and large windows, while the stepped building profile creates noticeably different outdoor areas between layouts. A larger advertised total can therefore mean a larger terrace rather than more enclosed living space. Berthing and yacht-club services belong to the wider marina offer; their cost and access are separate questions from buying an apartment.
research.locationNote: Aurea is within Rashid Yachts & Marina in Mina Rashid. The brochure identifies Sheikh Rashid Road and Al Mina Road as connections to the wider city, with Al Shindagha and the QE2 among the surrounding heritage destinations. Published journey times are indicative, and exact access should be checked on site.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s published selection starts at AED 2,310,888. The launch fact sheet gives one-, two- and three-bedroom starting prices of AED 2.31m, AED 3.32m and AED 4.89m respectively. These historic type prices do not confirm present stock or a quotation for a particular floor and view.
research.paymentNote: The launch document sets 10% at booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Later stages are linked to construction progress. Early calendar dates have passed, so obtain the current offer and outstanding instalment schedule for the selected apartment.
research.handoverNote: June 2030 is the payment document’s estimated construction-completion month, corroborated by Property Finder’s Q2 2030 entry. Contractual handover and current progress should be checked with Emaar.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: 169 apartments: 83 one-bedroom, 65 two-bedroom and 21 three-bedroom homes. This is the original collection, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Building and outdoor space
facts.value: Plans show ground, podium and 13 floors. Three-bedroom Type A4 on level 8 totals 2,483.77 sq ft: 1,450.22 sq ft suite and 1,033.55 sq ft balcony/terrace. It includes a maid’s room and laundry. Unit-specific totals must be compared on the same basis.
